title: Provider engagement duration controls and live remaining-time display

requirements.summary: Make provider engagement status interactive with an hours duration and immediate persistence.
acceptanceCriteria: ProviderProfilePage shows controls to set status to “Engaged” or “Not Engaged” with clear English labels and helper text.
When setting to “Engaged”, the UI collects an 'Hours engaged' value and calls the new backend API to set the engagement end time.
When setting to “Not Engaged”, the UI calls the backend API to clear engagement immediately.
On success, the page refreshes the current user profile query so the displayed status matches backend data.
On failure (authorization/validation), the UI shows a user-friendly English error message.

file_operations.description: Add React Query mutations for provider engagement updates using existing backend capabilities: a mutation that calls setEngaged(hours) and a mutation that calls disengage(); translate authorization/validation errors into user-friendly English messages; invalidate/refetch ['currentUserProfile'] (and provider queries where relevant) after successful updates.

Replace the current placeholder engagement section with interactive controls: an Engaged/Not Engaged toggle and an 'Hours engaged' numeric input required when engaging; wire the controls to the new mutations for immediate persistence; on success, show an English success toast and ensure the profile query refreshes; on failure, show an English error toast. Use existing shadcn-ui primitives already present in this file (Card, Input, Switch, Button, etc.) and verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create shared utilities to compute and format remaining engagement time from an optional engagement end time (bigint) for display (e.g., “Available in 2h 15m”), including safe handling when no end time is present or when time has expired.

requirements.summary: Show Engaged/Available plus remaining engaged time on client provider preview and detail surfaces.
acceptanceCriteria: ProviderPreviewDialog displays a clear status badge (“Engaged” / “Available”) and, when Engaged with an end time, also shows remaining time (e.g., “Available in 2h 15m”).
ProviderDetailPage displays the same engagement status and remaining-time information in English.
If no end time is available, the UI still shows Engaged/Available but does not show a misleading countdown.
All user-facing labels are in English.

file_operations.description: Enhance the availability section to show remaining engaged time when provider.isEngaged is true and provider.engagementEndTime exists (using the shared engagementTime utility); keep labels in English; avoid showing a countdown when no end time is present. Use existing shadcn-ui Badge/Card styling already used here and verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add remaining-time text near the existing Engaged/Available badge when an engagement end time is present, using the shared engagementTime utility; ensure English labels and avoid displaying a countdown when no end time exists.

requirements.summary: Make engagement status feel live via React Query polling and show a notice when it changes.
acceptanceCriteria: While ProviderPreviewDialog is open, the provider query refetches on an interval (keep the existing 3-second behavior pattern used elsewhere in the app).
While ProviderDetailPage is visible, the provider query refetches on an interval so engagement changes are reflected without a manual refresh.
When the engagement state changes between Engaged and Not Engaged, the client sees a clear in-app notice using the existing EngagementStatusNotice component (English text).
React Query cache invalidation/refetch is performed after provider updates engagement so client views converge quickly to backend values.

file_operations.description: When the ProviderPreviewDialog is open, enable 3-second polling on the selected provider query (React Query refetchInterval) and pass an EngagementStatusNotice into the dialog's existing engagementNotice slot; detect Engaged/Not Engaged transitions across refetches to show the notice with English text.

Enable 3-second polling for the provider query while the page is visible (React Query refetchInterval); detect Engaged/Not Engaged transitions across refetches and render EngagementStatusNotice to notify the client in English.

Ensure engagement mutations invalidate/refetch provider-related queries so client views converge quickly after provider updates; keep polling-friendly query keys consistent with existing useGetProvider queryKey usage.
